title: Altitude corridor and 3D view
description: Ground, planned altitude and the safe corridor along the route: a floor from terrain clearance and, optionally, the link's Fresnel clearance, and a ceiling above ground. Feeds the 3D view and the altitude profile, and gives waypoints without a height (or marked auto) the lowest height that keeps their legs in the corridor. Its climb assistant compares the plan with the energy-optimal climb through the corridor and simpler strategies, each offered as a fix.
author: rfmap
